nodes.label: ComfyUI Studio Page (local image tools)
nodes.rationale: Free local-GPU image tools in 4 tabs: generate (SD 1.5 DreamShaper, brand presets), 4x Real-ESRGAN upscale, inpaint (mask repaint), ControlNet keyframe. Calls /api/studio/brand, /api/studio/upload, /api/studio/run. Warns ControlNet is slow on 4 GB VRAM (use run_nvidia_lowvram.bat).

nodes.label: liitt / Fairy Flame Brand Kit (banks/liitt-brand-kit.json)
nodes.rationale: Brand presets (The Glow brand platform + angle bank) served by /api/studio/brand: prompt presets, a style_suffix (editorial mystic, indigo/gold Glow palette) and a brand negative_prompt auto-appended to image generation prompts.
